A package supplies functions that R does not provide on its own. `library()` attaches an already installed package for this session; it does not install it. Here, readxl reads spreadsheets, dplyr/tidyr (within tidyverse) reshape data, MASS and lme4 fit models, and the table and plotting packages format the output. If R reports that a package is missing, the setup has not finished.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| eval: false
```

## Data paths

`COHERO_DATA_DIR` is a setting supplied by an authorized analyst outside the repository. `Sys.getenv()` reads that setting and `file.path()` combines it with each filename. The explicit `stop()` prevents the script from continuing with an unspecified data folder. Reading this website does not require the files: its code blocks are displayed, not executed.

```{r}
#| label: data-paths
#| eval: false
```

## Define constants

These named objects collect the visit cutoff, questionnaire item lists, medication names, outcomes and subgroup variables used later. A vector such as `count_outcomes` is a list of column names; later loops repeat the same operation for each name. Changing a threshold or item list changes the analysis definition, so its justification belongs in the [analysis plan](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/COHERO-RCT-analysis/blob/main/analysis-plan.md), not just in this file.

```{r}
#| label: define-constants
#| eval: false
```
